answer: Attestations here are bucketed by join hour: all accounts registered in the same 60-minute window form one grove, and every vouch from that grove counts as one vote. A forger minting 1,000 fakes in one burst gets 1 vote; 1,000 votes needs 1,000 separate hours (~42 days) of staged signups. The ledger's quill stamps each join hour, so no hiding; a spiral of cohorts vouching back to one target forfeits their stake. Colluders joining together just merge into one grove. Honest users pay nothing.
